description.fun: A lonely spirit that possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea. It hopes you'll drink it so it can sap your life force from inside, but it tastes so awful it's always spat straight out. Most Sinistea live in fake antique cups; the rare genuine ones carry a maker's stamp underneath, and some collectors brew the perfect tea hoping to attract one.
description.guide: A Ghost-type Pokémon formed when a lonely spirit possesses leftover tea in a teacup. Most Sinistea are Phony Form, in forged cups; rare Antique Form ones have a stamp of authenticity. It evolves into Polteageist with a Cracked Pot or a Chipped Pot.
description.tagline: A haunted cup of tea that tastes too awful to drink

description.fun: A ghost made entirely of black tea, living in a cracked teapot. Its tea tastes delicious but sends chills through anyone who drinks it, and too much can be fatal; some daring gourmets drink it daily anyway. It multiplies by creeping into teapots and pouring itself into leftover tea, and its personality depends on the tea, not the pot.
description.guide: The evolution of Sinistea, a ghost made of black tea living in an old teapot. Its tea tastes good but causes chills and is dangerous in excess. Like Sinistea it comes in Phony and Antique forms, and it is unrelated to the lookalike Sinistcha.
description.tagline: A delicious, deadly pot of haunted tea

note.text: Only an Antique Form Sinistea, the rare one with a stamp of authenticity under its cup, evolves with the genuine Chipped Pot, and it becomes an Antique Form Polteageist. The common Phony Form needs the fake Cracked Pot.
